quiz: Final coding quiz · 12 November, 9:30–11:00 · 4 questions on HackerEarth · weeks 5–12

templates.what: Linked list: print, insert at the tail, print in reverse
BST: search, insert, max, in-order traversal, isValidBST
AVL tree: rotations and rebalancing after insert
Dijkstra's cheapest path between two cities
Quicksort with a Lomuto (and Hoare) partition

items.label: Warm-up b
items.task: `insert_into_set(s, value)`: add a value only if the set doesn't have it yet
items.note: No practice problem: it's one line with a set, `if value not in s: s.add(value)`.
